approved: owner 2026-10-17 (decision D18); 1.1 adds classification_conflict, owner 2026-10-29; 1.2 divergent scoring, owner 2026-10-30

rules.material: affected value > value_threshold_usd OR affected value / counted treasury value > treasury_share_threshold
rules.critical_core_input: a treasury-controlled address, token, contract, oracle or position representing >= critical_core_share_threshold of counted treasury value, or any required input whose absence makes the score non-reproducible or mathematically incomplete
rules.undetermined: the affected value cannot be calculated because the failed check prevents valuation; never assumed immaterial
rules.material_effect: provisional; affected value excluded or reclassified per class; confidence = min(confidence, confidence_cap)
rules.conflicts: all candidate values are preserved; never resolved automatically, never the most favourable value

contract_identity_control.non_material: retain the score, disclose the limitation
contract_identity_control.material: provisional; the affected position is excluded from verified value; confidence capped

realizability_control.rule: a signed exit check (exit.available / exit.simulated) that failed. Withdrawable fraction: exitable_ratio (insufficient liquidity); 0 (redemptions disabled); 1 - encumbered / position for collateral backing a loan, encumbered = debt / liquidation threshold read on chain (Aave v3 getUserAccountData), assigned to the positions whose full withdrawal reverts, largest first; not measured: the whole position counts as encumbered. An unexplained revert has no measurable basis: no discount, the whole position counts as unverified. An unavailable exit check is a disclosed data gap (flag only)
realizability_control.critical: as material when the divergence is measured (owner 2026-10-30): the score stays reproducible; review required
realizability_control.debt: the loan stays an obligation and the collateral stays in gross value: the debt is never subtracted twice

naming_control.rule: flag only when ownership is independently established (the wallet's control is verified from the registry, Safe configuration or governance record); otherwise confidence_cap by the gross affected value

price_comparison.rule: <= 2%: pass; > 2% and <= 5%: flag only (the engine values the position at the lower reading with 0 consistency points: a confidence limitation, never the more favourable price); > 5% on a material position: confidence_cap, both readings kept with their sources; no defensible price: the value is excluded (a data gap)

retrieval_control.rule: a transport or secondary-RPC failure (unavailable) with the primary state reproducible: flag only; a disagreement between sources on a material position: confidence_cap

disclosure_reconciliation.rule: the reported-vs-observed gap (USD) is the affected value: material: confidence_cap; large: review required. The observed value is never rewritten to match the report

classification_conflict.not_a_trigger: legal_restriction: a legal or governance earmark (e.g. a legal-defense reserve) is not enforced on chain, so a passing exit check does not contradict it
classification_conflict.rule: a position the curated data restricts (one of restrictive_flags) while a signed on-chain exit check (exit.available or exit.simulated) passes in full. Two different questions: can it be withdrawn on chain today (yes) and is it available treasury capital under the protocol's policy (unresolved). Never resolved automatically and never described as worthless or non-withdrawable: the observed value and the passed check are reported
classification_conflict.material: conservative exclusion: the position leaves verified and liquid value (it was already restricted), provisional, review required, confidence capped; no extra penalty points
classification_conflict.critical: as material: the conservative treatment keeps the score reproducible
classification_conflict.non_material: disclosed with review required; no score effect
classification_conflict.resolution: ordinary treasury capital confirmed: update the curated classification, the position counts subject to its exit result; restricted confirmed: the curated classification stays and the conflict is recorded as resolved; ambiguous: the conflict stays open

obligation_visibility.rule: existing obligations policy: a one-time obligations_penalty_points deduction when materially incomplete; insufficient_data when missing obligations make the score non-reproducible
obligation_visibility.deferred_until: Build C (owner 2026-10-17, D20): until the missing obligations can be valued, the existing rule stays live: PARTIAL_OBLIGATIONS_PENALTY (10 points, once per report) whenever obligations are partial and bounded, regardless of materiality

large_divergence.measured_on: the unavailable or unverified part of the position (value_usd, treasury_share); the gross position (position_share)

measures.materiality: the gross affected position (flag_only vs confidence_cap)
measures.score_credit: the verified available value (evidence-based discount on liquid capital)

treatments.flag_only: score 0, no status or confidence effect; the check stays visible
treatments.confidence_cap: provisional, confidence capped at confidence_cap, no penalty points
treatments.evidence_based_discount: as confidence_cap, and liquid capital (D2) counts position x measured withdrawable fraction; the rest is reported separately (restricted, encumbered, illiquid), never deleted
treatments.critical: insufficient_data, score null, review required: a >= critical_core_share_threshold input with no defensible value or attribution, or a non-reproducible score
